_note: How the Client Hub uses the brand pack's application colours (brand/ef-tokens.json, application). Each status is text and icon on its own tint, always with an icon and a word, never colour alone. The values themselves come from the pack through brand/tokens.json; this file only maps the app's statuses onto them. Checked by scripts/check-contrast.mjs. Client type accents live in public/config/client-types.json.
_textNote: Text colours that are not in the pack. placeholder is slate softened to a solid colour that still passes 4.5:1 on the warm white field (opacity is never used to mute text, because the contrast check cannot see it). onAccent is the text on a selected fit pill, a pressed filter chip and the current sub navigation pill.
